description: This file defines the CartActivity class for an Android app, managing the shopping cart UI, including displaying cart items, updating quantities, removing items, and navigating to checkout.
external_files: R (Resource file for layout IDs and string resources)

classes.name: CartActivity
classes.description: An activity that displays shopping cart contents, allows quantity adjustments, item removals, and navigation to checkout.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI elements, adapters, listeners, and populates the cart display.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the cart display by fetching items from the repository, updating the adapter, and displaying the total price.
